name: breuninger.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 6 pages ask search engines not to index them.
lesson: Review every noindex on purpose, and remove it from pages you want found.
summary: www.breuninger.com scores 79 out of 100 (C). 1 check fails now, 28 are at risk, and 39 pass. Fix first: 1 form control has no label.

fix.title: 1 form control has no label
fix.evidence: On /de/giftcard/. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 6 pages ask search engines not to index them
fix.fix: Remove noindex from pages that should be found, and keep it only on private or duplicate pages.

fix.title: 35 images below the first screen load straight away
fix.evidence: 2600618_Breuninger_Lena_HERO_510_zh4tsr… on /de/, 2600618_Breuninger_Christoph_HERO_151_u… on /de/, Moncler-280x140px_qgannj.jpg on /de/, loewe-SmallContentCarousel-Logo__mglisg… on /de/ and 31 more. They compete with the first screen for bandwidth.
fix.fix: Add loading="lazy" to images below the first screen, and keep it off the main image.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: A window the page opens, or that opens it, keeps a handle to it, which tabnabbing and cross-site leaks use. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin-allow-popups, or same-origin when the site opens no sign-in or payment popup.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Nothing on the page blocks the back/forward cache
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
